description_en: Calls the StopMPUTask operation to stop a stream relay task
description_zh: 调用StopMPUTask停止旁路转推任务
kebab_example: aliyun rtc stop-mpu-task --app-id yourAppId --task-id yourTaskId --region cn-hangzhou
name: StopMPUTask

parameters.help_en:
The application ID. Only a single ID can be passed.

You can create and query the application ID in the console (https://rtc.console.aliyun.com/manage/list#/manage/list)
parameters.help_zh:
应用ID，仅支持传单个ID。

您可以在控制台 (https://rtc.console.aliyun.com/manage/list#/manage/list)创建和查询
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. Only a single ID can be passed. The value must be the same as the TaskId parameter of https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93183.html
parameters.help_zh: 任务ID，仅支持传单个ID，和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93183.html入参TaskId一致
parameters.name: task_id
